title: Warmly Spiced Algerian Mutton Tagine
description: A hearty, solo-dinner Algerian dish featuring tender mutton and a rich, aromatic spice blend. Serve with couscous or crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds; toast, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly caramelized, 4-5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute.
Add the mutton pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 5-7 minutes.
Add the cinnamon sticks, ground cinnamon, ground cayenne pepper (if using), and 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the mutton is tender, 2-3 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
